prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent environment prop atlas for a Korean historical tower defense game.
Input image: approved winter-props-v2 atlas is STYLE and CAMERA reference only; preserve that original file. Create a NEW sibling atlas, with completely new subjects.
Primary request: six small village barriers and doorway cargo props in the same soft, sculpted, hand-painted animated-film aesthetic. High elevated fixed isometric view about 45 degrees downward, clearly visible top surfaces, consistent upper-left lighting and identical camera for every object. Quiet warm weathered timber, slate-blue fieldstone, muted earth-brown glazed pottery, desaturated navy shadows and restrained amber highlights. Neutral daytime illumination, no snow in this version.
Composition: exactly 3 columns by 2 rows in a 1536x1024 image, six equally sized cells, one isolated complete prop per cell. Each cell must contain only its own prop, comfortably separated by at least 48px of fully transparent gutters and 40px outer margins. Shapes should be compact and readable at small gameplay size.
Top row left: a LOW rustic Korean wooden rail fence, three stout uneven posts, two irregular horizontal rails, tapered post tops, a little rope binding, continuous sturdy silhouette, no spikes.
Top row middle: a different LOW wooden fence, two sturdy end posts, short rough horizontal rails with a subtly sagging center and one diagonal repair brace; clearly distinct silhouette from first fence. Keep barrier overall width under twice its visible height.
Top row right: a LOW short dry-stacked fieldstone boundary wall, rounded uneven blue-gray stones in three courses, a softly stepped asymmetric top, a few moss touches.
Bottom row left: another LOW fieldstone boundary wall, a rounded corner and a lower end section, larger irregular stones, a different contour from first stone wall. No tall pillars or roof tiles. Keep wall compact, no wider than twice visible height.
Bottom row middle: a compact cluster of three different sized traditional Korean onggi storage jars, dark brown glaze, one flat lid and one small woven basket at the base; all parts touching as ONE cohesive ground prop.
Bottom row right: a compact doorway supply pile with two aged wooden crates, one tied rolled muted linen bundle and a small rope coil; all parts touching as ONE cohesive ground prop.
Materials: painterly broad planes, gently rounded worn edges, selective carved grain and stone detail, no gritty photographic texture or plastic shine. Match the reference's illustrated volume and quality. No characters, no buildings, no whole environment, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no logos, no watermark. NO ground slab, NO cast shadow, NO halo, NO glow, NO detached particles, NO foliage sticking out across cell boundaries. True transparent alpha background outside the objects, including every gutter. All objects fully contained, nothing cropped.
